correctness.rationale: Homma and Ferreira–Speziali exhaust the two F7 classes. Both diagonal equations are smooth genus ten. In F49, sixth powers form the subgroup of order 8; the two exact polynomial gcd identities are T−1, giving 36 affine points each, with 6 versus 0 at infinity, hence 42 versus 36. Degree-two closed points (N2−N1)/2 equal 3 versus 0. Independent exact polynomial gcd checks corroborated; enumeration is not used as a proof beyond finite field.
